title: Sparkly yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='yg' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e63946'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b5172a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- string -->
  <line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='32' stroke='#ccddff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- yo-yo body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='24' fill='url(#yg)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#ff9bbf' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- inner rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3cc' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- center hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='8' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffe6a3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3' fill='#fff3c4'/>

  <!-- shine highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='47' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-30 43 47)'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- top right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(78,28)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- top left small sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(20,22)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(18,72)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(82,72)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#a8e6ff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#d4f1ff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#d4f1ff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny dots sparkle -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#ffb3cc'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='85' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='85' r='1.5' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
</svg>
